messages:
Sam L: Canary on dedicated-us-west (pool dedicated-gpu-2) shows p95 +60% after merge 9f4d2c3. Not customer-facing yet but SLA risk. Can we triage?

Priya R: Same in staging canary. KV cache eviction rate jumped ~4x. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc/kv-cache?panelId=7

Miguel C: Runtime logs point to KernelSelector preferring fused_attn for long sequences — memory working set increased and KV cache thrashing.

Tanya H: Batcher reacted to memory pressure and reduced batch sizes, throughput fell. p50 ok; p95/p99 degraded.

Alex W: Repro locally with synthetic seq=2048. Selector snippet:
```
[KernelSelector] model=m7b seq=2048 chosen=fused_attn_v2 score=0.87 alt=split_attn score=0.72 mem_est=13.2GB
[KVCache] available_slots=2048 evictions=312 -> 1280/s
[Batcher] target_batch_size=32 adjusted->8 due_to_memory_pressure
```

CI Bot: perf-check: PR 1839 (kernel-refactor) p95 regression on dedicated perf job. baseline=108ms -> candidate=164ms (+48%). Full: https://ci.redwood/local/job/1839/perf

Sam L: Need fast mitigation to unblock Dedicated rollout. Options: revert 9f4d2c3, runtime flag to bias selector to split_attn on dedicated, or relax batching heuristic. Quickest?

Miguel C: Quick patch: detect mem_pressure and bias selector toward split_attn for seq>1024. Local: mem down ~30%, p95 ~115ms. Pushing PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4021

Priya R: Prefer flag so we can toggle without revert. Scope to dedicated pools only.

oncall-rotations: Pausing canary rollout across dedicated pools now. HOLD.

DeployBot: Canary rollout paused by @oncall-rotations at 2026-03-18T12:40:00Z

Sam L: Miguel, prep revert PR too in case patch has edge cases.

Miguel C: Started bisect: culprit commit 9f4d2c3 (kernel selection refactor). Revert PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4022

Alex W: Canary with selector-bias + feature-flag ON for dedicated: p95=118ms, KV evictions near baseline. Looks good.

Priya R: OK to land flag+patch to canary nodes only, then re-run dedicated canary. Add alerts for eviction_rate and p95.

Sam L: Opened incident INC-2026-1823 (Dedicated rollout blocked by kernel selector regression). Assign eng-runtime & eng-ml.

Miguel C: Follow-ups: include mem_est and cache impact in scoring, add perf regression unit tests for long sequences.

Sam L: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
